name: HVAC Filter
summary: Disposable filter that traps dust before air enters the furnace or AC.
education: A clean filter improves efficiency and protects the blower motor and coils from buildup. Higher MERV ratings catch finer particles but restrict airflow more, so pick a rating your system can handle without straining.

suggested_photos.prompt: The filter showing its size printed on the frame

maintenance.cadence_text: Every 1-3 months while the system runs
maintenance.why: A clogged filter strains the blower, raises bills, and lets dust through gaps.
